description: Three freehold/virtual-freehold government-leased properties acquired from Elite Phoenix Limited via Elite Dram Limited
property_name: Custom House, Felixstowe; Merlin House, Carmarthen; Priory Court, Dover
counterparty: Elite Phoenix Limited (related corporation of the Manager)
note: Consideration GBP 9.2m (related-party acquisition; Note 32 IPT GBP 9,200k). Acquisition cost recognised in investment properties GBP 9,644,000 (Note 4, incl. transaction costs); cash outflow GBP 9,644k. WALE 7.4 years at 31 Mar 2025; GRI yield 9.2%. Partially funded by GBP 4.0m private placement. Acquired below valuation: aggregate independent valuation GBP 10.7m by Colliers as at 31 Dec 2025 (Custom House 3.7 / Merlin House 2.3 / Priory Court 4.7) per Acquisitions table (PAGE 25).
gain_on_divestment_basis: vs_valuation (DERIVED, flagged): (purchase_price 9,200,000 - Colliers valuation 10,700,000 as at 31 Dec 2025)/10,700,000 = -14.02% (acquired BELOW valuation). Per-property purchase/valuation (GBP'm): Custom House 3.4/3.7, Merlin House 1.8/2.3, Priory Court 4.0/4.7. Manager commentary cites a 7.6% discount to the AVERAGE of independent valuations (Colliers+CBRE) and 9.2% GRI yield -- commentary, NOT used.
